description: Source file implementing the CompositionEngine class for Android's SurfaceFlinger, including methods for creating displays, managing hardware composer, render engine, and performing composition updates.

classes.name: CompositionEngine
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing composition of layers and display output in Android SurfaceFlinger.

methods.name: createDisplay
methods.description: Creates and returns a new display object based on provided creation arguments.

methods.name: createLayerFECompositionState
methods.description: Creates a new Layer Front-End Composition State object.

methods.name: getHwComposer
methods.description: Returns a reference to the HWComposer instance used by the engine.

methods.name: setHwComposer
methods.description: Sets the HWComposer instance used by the engine.

methods.name: getRenderEngine
methods.description: Returns a reference to the RenderEngine used for rendering layers.

methods.name: setRenderEngine
methods.description: Sets the RenderEngine used for rendering.

methods.name: getTimeStats
methods.description: Returns the TimeStats object for performance metrics.

methods.name: setTimeStats
methods.description: Sets the TimeStats object for performance metrics.

methods.name: needsAnotherUpdate
methods.description: Checks if another composition update is needed.

methods.name: getLastFrameRefreshTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last frame refresh.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Performs the composition and presentation of layers to the display.

methods.name: updateCursorAsync
methods.description: Updates cursor position asynchronously for hardware cursors.

methods.name: preComposition
methods.description: Prepares layers for composition, determining if another update is needed.

methods.name: getFeatureFlags
methods.description: Returns feature flags for the composition engine.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Dumps the internal state for debugging.

methods.name: setNeedsAnotherUpdateForTest
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating if another update is needed, for testing purposes.
